error[ZC-E0816]: a TLS connection ended or stalled without close_notify
  cause  the server's connection ended before the handshake finished
  fix    Retry the request: what arrived before the break may be incomplete.
  more   zcube explain E0816 · rerun with --verbose for the full cause chain
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigcube/errors/E0816.html
